Name: Ucal
Summary: Ucal was one of the two men to whom Agur addressed his words in Proverbs 30, named alongside Ithiel in its opening verse.
KeyStory: Agur's oracle was spoken to Ithiel and Ucal; nothing more is told of Ucal, but his name is preserved as a hearer of wisdom.
LifeLesson: Ucal's place in Scripture honours the hearer of wisdom, not only its speaker.
